description: Build a comprehensive end-to-end test harness for the Creel daemon, dashboard, and API. One script to set up a test environment, start the daemon with real LLM calls, run unit tests, Playwright e2e tests against the dashboard, and integration tests against the API. Tears down cleanly afterward.

userStories.title: Test harness orchestration script
userStories.description: A single shell script that sets up a test environment, starts the daemon, runs all tests, and tears down.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/test-harness/harness.sh that orchestrates the full test lifecycle
Step 1: Create temp test home directory (~/.creel-test/) with minimal agent config
Step 2: Copy test agent.yml from scripts/test-harness/test-config/agent.yml to test home
Step 3: Start the Creel daemon using the test config (CREEL_HOME=~/.creel-test creel daemon start or equivalent)
Step 4: Wait for daemon health check (GET /health on port 8099) to respond
Step 5: Run pytest (existing unit tests: pytest tests/ -x -q)
Step 6: Run integration API tests (scripts/test-harness/test-api.py)
Step 7: Run Playwright e2e tests against the dashboard
Step 8: Stop the daemon (creel daemon stop or kill the process)
Step 9: Clean up ~/.creel-test/
Exit code 0 if all tests pass, non-zero on any failure
Trap signals to ensure cleanup happens on Ctrl-C or failure
Print summary at end: unit count, integration count, e2e count, pass/fail
Accept --skip-unit, --skip-e2e, --skip-integration flags for partial runs
Accept --keep-running flag to leave daemon up for debugging
userStories.notes: Daemon serves dashboard at port 8099. Dashboard token is in ~/.creel/dashboard-token (or ~/.creel-test/dashboard-token for test). The daemon is started via the Python package entry point. Check how DaemonService starts in src/taskrunner/daemon/service.py. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY must be set in env for real LLM calls.

userStories.title: Test configuration and agent definition
userStories.description: Minimal but complete agent config for the test environment that enables real LLM calls.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/test-harness/test-config/agent.yml — minimal Creel agent config
Config uses real LLM (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) with low max_tokens (200) to keep costs minimal
System prompt: 'You are a test assistant. Keep responses brief.'
No channels configured (no Telegram/iMessage — pure API testing)
Session config: max_history 10, sessions stored in test home dir
Workspace path set to a temp directory
No tools configured (or minimal safe tools like weather)
Create scripts/test-harness/test-config/setup.py that initializes the test home directory
Setup script: creates ~/.creel-test/, copies agent.yml, generates dashboard-token
Setup script: creates required subdirectories (sessions/, logs/, tasks/)
Document required env vars in a README: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY must be set
userStories.notes: Look at the AgentDefinition model in src/taskrunner/models.py for the exact YAML schema. The daemon reads from ~/.creel/ by default — we override with CREEL_HOME env var or equivalent CLI flag. Check how the daemon locates its config.

userStories.title: API integration tests
userStories.description: Integration tests that hit the live daemon API with real LLM calls to verify core functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/test-harness/test-api.py — standalone test script using requests library
Test: GET /health returns 200 with status ok
Test: GET /v1/status returns daemon status with expected fields (uptime, sessions, channels)
Test: POST /v1/messages with a simple prompt returns an LLM response (real API call)
Test: GET /v1/sessions lists at least one session after sending a message
Test: GET /v1/sessions/active returns the current active session
Test: GET /v1/sessions/{id}/history returns message history including the test message
Test: POST /v1/sessions/new creates a fresh session
All requests include the dashboard token in Authorization header (Bearer token)
Script reads token from ~/.creel-test/dashboard-token
Script waits up to 30s for LLM response (real API calls may be slow)
Exit code 0 on all pass, non-zero on any failure
Each test prints PASS/FAIL with description
userStories.notes: The daemon API is at localhost:8099. Auth is via dashboard token (Bearer header). POST /v1/messages takes {message: string} and returns {response: string} or streams. Check the exact request/response schemas in src/taskrunner/daemon/api.py and contracts.py.

userStories.title: Playwright setup for dashboard
userStories.description: Configure Playwright to test the Creel dashboard web UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Create dashboard/playwright.config.ts with baseURL http://localhost:8099
Add @playwright/test to dashboard devDependencies
Configure 1 project: chromium (desktop viewport 1440x900)
Create dashboard/e2e/fixtures/auth.ts that handles dashboard token authentication
Auth fixture enters the dashboard token on the login/auth screen
Add 'test:e2e' script to dashboard/package.json: 'npx playwright test'
Dashboard e2e tests go in dashboard/e2e/*.spec.ts
Install Playwright browsers as part of setup
userStories.notes: Dashboard source is on the ralph/dashboard branch — you need to merge or cherry-pick it first. Dashboard uses MUI v6 + React + TypeScript. Auth is a token entry screen. The dashboard is served as static files by the daemon at /dashboard/ or root.

userStories.title: Dashboard overview and navigation e2e tests
userStories.description: Playwright tests for the dashboard overview page and navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Create dashboard/e2e/overview.spec.ts
Test: dashboard loads and shows the overview page
Test: overview shows daemon status (running, uptime)
Test: overview shows session count
Test: navigation sidebar has links: Overview, Tasks, Cron, Files, Config, Logs
Test: clicking each nav link loads the corresponding page without error
Test: task list page loads (may be empty)
Test: cron page loads and shows cron job list (may be empty)
Test: config page loads and shows agent configuration
Test: logs page loads
userStories.notes: Dashboard pages: OverviewPage, TaskListPage, CronPage, FilesPage, ConfigPage, LogsPage. Check the App.tsx router for exact paths. MUI components — look for MUI-specific selectors or use text content.

userStories.title: Dashboard task and cron management e2e tests
userStories.description: Playwright tests for creating and managing tasks and cron jobs via the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Create dashboard/e2e/tasks.spec.ts
Test: navigate to task list, click 'New Task' button
Test: fill in task form (name, prompt) and submit — verify task appears in list
Test: click a task to view its detail page
Test: edit a task and save changes
Create dashboard/e2e/cron.spec.ts
Test: navigate to cron page
Test: create a new cron job with schedule and prompt
Test: cron job appears in the list with correct schedule
Test: can toggle cron job enabled/disabled
Test: can delete a cron job
userStories.notes: Tasks are YAML files in the tasks/ directory. Cron jobs are managed via the daemon API. Check TaskNewPage.tsx and CronPage.tsx for form fields and button labels.

userStories.title: Chat and LLM interaction e2e test
userStories.description: Playwright test that sends a message through the dashboard chat UI and verifies an LLM response.
acceptanceCriteria: Create dashboard/e2e/chat.spec.ts
Test: find the chat/message input on the overview or dedicated chat page
Test: type a simple message ('What is 2+2?') and submit
Test: wait for LLM response to appear (up to 30s — real API call)
Test: response contains relevant content (not an error message)
Test: message history shows both user message and assistant response
This test makes a REAL LLM call — set generous timeout
userStories.notes: This is the most important e2e test — it verifies the full loop: dashboard UI → daemon API → LLM → response displayed. The chat interface may be on the overview page or a session detail page. Check the dashboard source for where message sending happens.
